@graph.description:
Runtime blackbox analog of nav2_system_tests/src/planning (main; CSV row 46). The
upstream suite directly exercises PlannerTester with synthetic costmaps, randomized
endpoints, planner plugins and is_path_valid. This campaign runs the real planner
through bt_navigator for 300 deterministic PathVariationRandom start/goal pairs,
records the generated /plan, and includes /behavior_tree_log plus BT coverage.
Direct synthetic-costmap and plugin assertions are documented as not portable in
readme.md. The success rate is intentionally not an optimization objective; the
purpose of this campaign is behavior-tree tracking across varied paths.
@graph.title: Nav2 planner runtime analog, TurtleBot 4 + Nav2, in roqsim (MuJoCo)
